FROM FIRST NOTES TO FIRST SOLO. ✈️🎶

For a high school musician who dreams of flying, the next big performance could happen in the cockpit.

The Flying Musicians Association is accepting nominations for its 2027 Solo Program, helping young musicians train toward their first solo flight.

General Aviation News reports that the scholarship includes approximately 15 hours of dual flight instruction and training materials. Recipients also become FMA youth ambassadors for their regions.

High school juniors and seniors must be nominated by their music director or teacher. Nominations close January 31, 2027; additional age, consent, citizenship and medical eligibility requirements apply, so check the program details before submitting.

Hours of practice, careful listening and steady concentration already shape a young musician’s progress. This program offers a chance to carry that dedication into a whole new skill—and a first solo worth celebrating. 💛

Know a student with music in their life and aviation on their mind? Share this with their music teacher.

Sources: Flying Musicians Association; General Aviation News, November 3, 2026.
